guitar.notes: John Denver was known for playing Guild acoustics (D-40, F-50) live and on recordings.

tone.target: warm strummed acoustic folk with natural room
tone.profile: warm strummed acoustic folk with natural room
tone.summary: The rig focuses on simulating a warm, strummed acoustic folk sound using an IR and light compression, avoiding aggressive amp models or modulation effects.
corrections: Use acoustic guitar IR not electric clean

rig.name: John Denver - Rocky Mountain High - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and maintain a natural recording feel.
blocks.gap: None. Standard practice for clean folk tones.

blocks.purpose: Provide gentle compression to smooth the strumming dynamics and enhance sustain, mimicking fingerpicking consistency.
blocks.gap: The Comp module is ideal for acoustic tone leveling. No specific alternative needed.

blocks.purpose: No drive or distortion is required for a dry folk texture.
blocks.gap: The 'None' setting ensures the signal remains clean and natural.

blocks.purpose: Select a clean, non-aggressive American amp core to provide warmth without the character of an electric tube sound.
blocks.gap: While acoustic IRs are preferred, US Deluxe provides a suitable clean platform if no dedicated acoustic preamp is available. Keep gain very low.

blocks.purpose: Crucial module. Use a dedicated acoustic guitar IR to capture the desired natural, warm sound and avoid electric amp coloration.
blocks.gap: The use of 'User IR 1' is mandatory here; it represents the required acoustic source simulation.

blocks.purpose: Fine-tune the frequency response, emphasizing the mid-high frequencies for clarity and strumming definition while maintaining warmth.
blocks.gap: Standard EQ shaping to enhance acoustic string resonance and cut harsh high end.

blocks.purpose: No wah or filtering is needed; the tone must remain natural and uncolored.
blocks.gap: Ensures the signal path remains clean for a folk sound.

blocks.purpose: Avoid all modulation (Chorus, Tremolo) as per the musical verdict.
blocks.gap: Keeps the tone dry and natural.

blocks.purpose: Provide a subtle, natural room ambiance without sounding artificial or overly wet.
blocks.gap: Room reverb is specified over Plate/Spring to achieve the desired 'natural room' feel.

blocks.purpose: Final output level adjustment to match the recording's dynamic range.

improvements.summary: Focus on optimizing the IR and reverb for maximum naturalness.

proposals.recommendedAsset: High-quality acoustic room IR (e.g., vintage wood)
proposals.reason: Enhance the 'natural room' feel and warmth of the strummed sound.
Capture the percussive attack and body resonances of acoustic strumming.
